name: Ahab king of Israel
description: Narrated royal decision-maker who seeks counsel about Ramoth-gilead.

name: Micaiah son of Imlah
description: Narrated prophet who discloses the heavenly council vision to Ahab.

name: Ahab's court prophets
description: A narrated prophetic group whose favorable counsel is contrasted with Micaiah's warning.
persistenceCriteria: group identity within the counsel scene

name: Royal counsel system
description: The courtly arrangement of kingship, consultation, prophets, and war deliberation represented in the narrative.
persistenceCriteria: recurrent court roles and decision practices

name: Favorable prophecy preference pattern
description: A proposed pattern in which desired outcomes shape receptivity to counsel.
persistenceCriteria: requires broader textual and comparative support

name: The lying spirit
description: The spirit described in Micaiah's vision as proposing deceptive mediation through prophetic speech.
identityCriteria: identified by the narrative as a spirit
associated with a specific proposal in the council scene
persistenceCriteria: bounded to the reported vision unless further tradition evidence is added

name: YHWH in the council vision
description: The enthroned divine actor in Micaiah's reported council vision.
identityCriteria: enthroned speaker in the council scene
persistenceCriteria: canonical identity supplied by the biblical text and theological tradition
